# Calculate the cumulative sum of the 'Dagger_inter' values over time
time_series_df['cumulative_dagger_inter'] = time_series_df['Dagger_inter'].cumsum()

# Identify the century when the cumulative sum begins to show a significant increase
# Group the data by century and calculate the cumulative sum
time_series_df['century'] = (time_series_df['CE'] // 100) * 100
century_data = time_series_df.groupby('century')['cumulative_dagger_inter'].sum().reset_index()

# Display the cumulative sum by century
century_data.head()

# Calculate the rate of change in the cumulative sum over time
century_data['rate_of_change'] = century_data['cumulative_dagger_inter'].diff()

# Identify the century with the highest rate of change
max_rate_century = century_data.loc[century_data['rate_of_change'].idxmax()]['century']
max_rate_century
